You will work closely with the leadership team, identify opportunities for scale, translate business priorities into actionable plans and ensure seamless execution across teams.
 🎯 What you will own 
 🚀 Company-level bets end to end: identifying opportunities, evaluating a new market, driving retention initiatives and building new revenue lines.
 🛠️ Zero-to-one builds: taking new initiatives from ideation to execution, defining the scope, aligning resources, building teams and measuring outcomes.

About The Role
 For problem-solvers who want to learn fast, own real outcomes and build alongside the founders.
Sure is an early-stage fintech, and this role sits right next to the founders. There's no fixed lane. Each week you'll be pointed at whatever matters most: launching something new, fixing something broken, cracking a partnership, getting a deal over the line, or sorting out a messy problem nobody owns yet. You take it from "we should figure this out" to done.
If you like variety, hate waiting for permission and get a kick out of making things happen, this is built for you.
If you want to learn faster than your job title suggests and you're the person who gets things done, we should talk.
What you'll do
 Founder priorities: research, plan and execute the initiatives the founders are driving, from idea to launch
 Growth and partnerships: help find, pitch and close partners, run experiments and figure out what moves the numbers
 Business operations: build and fix the processes behind the company, including vendors, finance and compliance, hiring and onboarding
 Data and decisions: pull the numbers together, find the insight and turn it into a clear recommendation
 Fundraising and investors: decks, data rooms, investor updates and diligence
 Special projects: anything that's important, urgent and doesn't have an owner yet

 A problem-solver. You take vague, messy problems, break them down and find a way through
 A go-getter. You don't wait to be told. If something is stuck, you chase it, unblock it and close the loop
 A fast learner. You're happy to work on things you've never done before and get good at them quickly

 Work directly with the founders: sit in the room where decisions get made on product, growth, fundraising and hiring

leads.jd:
Cardboard (cardboard.ai) is an AI video editor that turns raw footage into finished videos, from social clips and highlight reels to product demos, launch videos and event recaps. Describe the video you want, and Cardboard turns your clips, photos, recordings or a link into an edit you can watch, change and export, in the browser, in the Mac app, or right inside ChatGPT and Claude. It pulls out the best moments, removes pauses and filler words, adds captions, titles, music and B-roll, and reframes for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. It’s built for marketing teams, founders and creators who need video every week without learning a timeline.

Say what you need, like “three 30-second ad variants” or “a customer testimonial from these interviews”, and Cardboard’s AI agent, Director, builds a first cut in minutes. You refine it by chatting or on a full timeline, with your team. Cardboard edits the footage you already have. Unlike AI video generators such as Runway or Sora, it doesn’t create new video from a text prompt.

- Recreate the style of a reference video with your own footage.
- Make motion graphics from a prompt, from animated titles to 3D scenes like a spinning product shot.
- Cut to the beat, with match cuts, transitions and effects synced to the music.
- 80+ ready-made recipes (templates) for videos like launch videos, product showcases, podcast clips, webinar highlights, and testimonials.
- Export the finished video, or hand the timeline off to Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

Why now: AI models can finally understand video, and WebGPU makes a professional editor possible in a browser tab. Most AI video tools are either an old editor with AI bolted on, or an agent with no real editor behind it. Cardboard is built to be both.

Team: Saksham Aggarwal (CEO) and Ishan Sharma (CTO) have been friends for 15 years, since school. Saksham studied computer science at BITS Pilani, was co-founder and CTO of Iterate AI (backed by Entrepreneur First), and worked in growth at Sequoia-backed Flint. Ishan spent nearly five years building performance-critical browser apps at HackerRank (YC S11), and at 14 built Hotspoter, a Windows app with over 5 million downloads.

Together, they are unusually suited to build the editor core others avoid.

Video is becoming the default distribution channel, and the team that iterates fastest compounds attention. Cardboard becomes the default workspace for video production, the way Canva/Figma became the workspace for design - because it’s collaborative, fast, and does the tedious parts for you.

leads.company_note: YC Winter 2021 · team of 100 · Leading online after-school for kids & teens to learn AI & coding
leads.title: Founder's Office (speculative note to founders)
leads.jd:
Codingal (www.codingal.com) is the global leader in online AI and coding education for kids and teens (Grades 1-12). Our mission is to help students fall in love with AI & coding and become creators of the future - entrepreneurs, engineers, and scientists by providing high-quality, accessible, and personalized computer science education.

In many countries, top technical universities exist, but there’s a significant gap in K-12 programming education. Parents want their kids to start learning programming early, and that’s why they choose Codingal. We offer live, interactive classes with expert instructors from Computer Science backgrounds. All our instructors are rigorously vetted and trained to ensure a high-quality learning experience.

Every student receives a personalized learning path tailored to their age and skill level. Our curriculum is STEM.org-accredited, aligned with the K–12 Computer Science Framework, and delivered in 1:1 and small-group formats, ensuring individual attention and engagement.

Students learn by building real-world projects using popular tools and technologies like Scratch, Python, Roblox, Minecraft, MIT App Inventor, Thunkable, Pygame, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, website development, Java, Data Science, AP Computer Science content, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Machine Learning frameworks. Through this hands-on approach, students create apps, games, animations, and websites in a fun, engaging way that fosters problem-solving and creative skills.

Beyond classes, students participate in global coding competitions, hackathons like HPE CodeWars, and online coding camps, further nurturing their creativity, confidence, and innovative spirit. With a 4.9/5 student rating and NPS of 86, Codingal is trusted by over 1 million registered students in 70+ countries.

Codingal combines the best of human instruction and AI-driven learning to inspire the next generation of tech leaders. We are poised to lead the next generation of coding education and make a significant impact in this rapidly growing market.

leads.company_note: YC Summer 2020 · team of 25 · Ecosystem Platform for Restaurants in India
leads.title: Data Analyst
leads.jd:
Explorex — The Memory Layer for Physical Commerce

~90% of Indian retail happens in person, yet offline venues have no memory of their customers. Restaurants run on disconnected tools, and every visit ends with zero data captured. Explorex fixes this by owning both sides of the dining transaction.

At the center is Elite, our consumer app that is redefining how people dine out. Diners see live table availability, browse dynamic menus, order, and self-checkout instantly — no waiting, no interruptions. Behind it sits our infrastructure stack: Bridge OS (the full-stack restaurant operating system), Clyro (WhatsApp-native CRM), and ReserveX — all feeding a single behavioral data layer.

That data layer is what makes Explorex fundamentally different. Delivery platforms only see orders. We capture real-world, in-venue behavior — what people order, how long they stay, how groups behave, how menus perform, how experiences shape spending. Because we operate the restaurant OS and the consumer touchpoint, this data is irreplicable.

We're now building Elara, an AI dining concierge that turns this data into real-time decision-making — factoring intent, context, availability, and historical behavior. This moves us beyond discovery into becoming the intelligence layer for offline commerce.

Today, Explorex powers 250+ partner restaurants and 3M+ diners across Bangalore and Hyderabad, processing 8M+ transactions annually (18M+ lifetime), and operates at breakeven.

Explorex is not a SaaS tool — it is the infrastructure layer for offline dining, with AI and consumer experience at its core. Think Shopify for restaurants, on its way to becoming the UPI of restaurant operations.
